🚀 Hiring: Product Intern (AI & SaaS)
We're looking for a Product Intern to work on AI and SaaS products from our office in Noida Sector 62.
Preferred candidates:
• Recent Engineering graduates (2024/2025/2026 pass-outs)
• Recent MBA graduates
• Strong interest in Product Management, AI, and SaaS
• Prior Product Management internship experience is a plus
You'll work closely with product and engineering teams on product research, requirement gathering, feature planning, and execution.
📍 Work from Office: Noida Sector 62

We're hiring an Associate Product Manager at Saber Money!
At Saber, we are building one of India’s most comprehensive B2B payment platforms. Our unified infrastructure helps businesses orchestrate payments seamlessly across PGs, wallets, and direct banking channels. We’re processing millions of transactions and growing fast.
We are looking for a high-agency APM to join our core product team. You will work directly with our engineering and operations teams to launch new features, optimize payment success rates, and build robust internal tools.
You are a great fit if:
- You have 1-2 years of product experience (Fintech/Payments is a huge plus)
- You understand APIs, webhooks, and basic system architecture
- You are obsessed with metrics and user flows
- You have an engineering or highly analytical background

We are looking for a highly motivated AI Product Intern to join us at Blue Machines.
About us:
Blue Machines is building state-of-the-art multi-agent infrastructure for enterprise workflows. We are backed by top-tier VCs and have a fast-growing waitlist of B2B clients.
Your Role:
- Research cutting-edge LLM architectures and agentic frameworks
- Help structure and manage product roadmaps
- Work closely with our founding engineering team to prototype agent workflows
- Assist in customer discovery and defining user requirements
Requirements:
- Strong passion for AI, LLMs, and Generative models
- Previous internship experience in product management or software engineering

expected.matchedStrengths: prototyping agent workflows and LLM architectures

Are you passionate about building products that blend AI, data, and advertising technology? Do you thrive in fast-paced environments where your work directly impacts global brands and campaigns?
At Silverpush, we're looking for an Associate Product Manager (APM) to join our Product team and help shape the future of advertising intelligence across YouTube, CTV, Programmatic, and Open Web channels.

  Drive product roadmaps from ideation to launch
  Collaborate with Engineering, Design, Data Science, and GTM teams
